newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft plans to raise HEW stake.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft plans to raise HEW stake.

text.p: Sydkraft intends to increase its stake in German electricity group Hamburgische Electricitaets-Werke AG (HEW), Sydkraft chief executive Goran Ahlstrom said on Friday.
"We will increase our stake further. Our aim is to reach a 20 percent stake," Ahlstrom told Reuters in an interview.
Sydkraft currently has 13.3 percent of the shares in HEW and plans to gradually obtain more shares.
HEW said on Monday it had obtained 15.7 percent of the share capital in Sydkraft, laying the groundwork for possible cooperation.
"We have known that they were interested... It's positive for us that our partner is interested in us," Ahlstrom said.
Ahlstrom said Sydkraft is continuously looking at possible purchases. Companies with business in densely populated regions are of greatest interest to the company.
Ahlstrom did not want to specify which geographic regions Sydkraft was looking at for possible purchases, but added: "We are not looking far away."
Great Britain or countries in the Far East are not interesting except possibly on the consultancy and service side, he said.
